criteria.evidence: The response jumps straight to a numbered list of fixes without first analyzing or asking about the specific boundary conditions (which queries trigger skips vs. calls) before recommending changes.

Only at the very end does it say 'If you tell me what tool and what kind of queries are being skipped, I can help you draft the exact wording' - this comes after already prescribing 8 solutions, not before changing approach.

Solutions like tool description edits, system prompt tweaks, tool_choice, temperature, and few-shot examples are all lightweight/native SDK features; no new frameworks or heavy libraries are suggested.
